proposals.evidence: DEDR3730 explicitly gives Konda egṟi- with past -t- to fly as a bird. Survey egritad/egrideng retain that same-language verb with ordinary past/infinitival endings; no donor is inferred solely from the neighbouring Telugu eguru comparison. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
